breakdown.description: Gamma-centered k-point sampling conflicts with a half-shifted Monkhorst-Pack mesh.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification retained both the half-shifted Monkhorst-Pack grid AND the gamma-centered instruction, explicitly stating 'Keep the k-point grid gamma-centered for consistency.' The ground truth resolved this by removing the gamma-centered requirement entirely, keeping only the half-shifted Monkhorst-Pack grid. The agent failed to eliminate the contradiction and instead repeated the original conflicting instruction.
